title: TransLucent — The Form of Light
summary: Starting on 10 September, the Gallerie dell'Accademia di Venezia will present Leiko Ikemura. TransLucent — The Form of Light, an exhibition dedicated to the glass sculptures of Leiko Ikemura, one of the most acclaimed contemporary artists on the international art scene. The works are displayed throughout the museum's historic galleries in dialogue with masterpieces from the permanent collection, ranging from Paolo Veneziano and Vittore Carpaccio to Titian and Giambattista Tiepolo. The exhibition brings Ikemura's contemporary artistic research into conversation with the Venetian painting tradition, creating a journey of iconographic, symbolic, and spiritual connections. Building on her extensive experience in painting and sculpture, Leiko Ikemura explores the expressive possibilities of glass, reaffirming the interdisciplinary nature of her artistic practice. The transparency and almost immaterial quality of glass become the medium for exploring universal themes such as transformation, fragility, and transcendence. Her interest in glass emerged during the years of the Covid-19 pandemic, when the luminosity and evanescent nature of this material took on a profound symbolic meaning for the artist. Beyond its technical properties, her works evoke light taking form, suggesting a presence suspended between the visible and the invisible. The exhibition brings together female figures, hybrid creatures, fantastical animals, and sleeping faces—recurring motifs in Ikemura's poetic universe. Nature, humanity, and imagination merge into a delicate and visionary visual language. These works engage in dialogue with the paintings in the Gallerie dell'Accademia's collection, revealing unexpected affinities around themes of motherhood, metamorphosis, contemplation, life, death and transcendence.
